name: Pip
subtitle: Pip, the money tracker with a coin mascot
description: Add this source to install Pip and get its updates.

apps.name: Pip
apps.subtitle: Track spending with Pip
apps.localizedDescription: Log what you spend in seconds, keep a daily streak, and see where your money goes. Pip cheers you on.
apps.versionDescription: Payday forecast: tap the new line on your money card to see what you'll have on payday, the bills still to come, and how much a day keeps you on track. The Lock Screen widget shows it too. Also fixed: a failed save can no longer log an entry twice, the round-up preview matches what goes into your goal when a friend paid, hidden categories stay off the Quick log widget, and a bad backup can't replace a good one.
